title: Auto Loans: is a prepayment charge added to a same-day payoff?
content:
# Auto Loans: is a prepayment charge added to a same-day payoff?

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower asks to pay an auto loan off today by a transfer from their own PCB checking account. It decides whether a Prepayment Penalty is added to the payoff amount.

## Clause

A Prepayment Penalty of the product's Prepayment Penalty percentage of the principal recomputed from the loan's ledger, rounded to the cent, is added when that percentage is above zero. Nothing is added when the percentage is zero.

## Branch table

| Product's Prepayment Penalty percentage | Prepayment Penalty added |
|---|---|
| above zero | that percentage of the principal, rounded to the cent |
| zero | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration (illustrative percentage, not a product value)

For illustration only, with a percentage of 1.00 and principal of 12658.45, the Prepayment Penalty would be 126.5845, rounded to 126.58. With a percentage of zero, nothing is added whatever the principal.

## Points of judgement

**Is the Prepayment Penalty taken on the whole payoff amount?** No. It is a percentage of the principal only, not of interest or fees.
